name: SH2 Spike - Right Probe (CastingSource)
description: Replaces Animations\MSCO_left1.hkx with the MRh_SpellFire_Event copy while SpellHotbar_CastingSource (SpellHotbar.esp 0x835) reads RIGHT (1). Conditioned on that ONE global and nothing else, so a hit or a miss names exactly one variable. If the OAR Animation Log picks this submod during a right-assigned hotbar cast, OAR can see the casting-source global while the shtb state holds the graph.
